player_prompt.intro:
Aweyiɣaɣa Player {player_id} leɣaɣ Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma we ɛyaa {num_rounds} tuuɖe.

Kpɛlɛɛyɔɔ:
- Pɩnzɩ pɩnzɩ ɛyaa {total_conversation_rounds} tuuɖe nɩɩyɛ tɔm kpɛlɛɛyɔɔ.
- Pʋwayɩ, pɩnzɩ pɩnzɩ pawɩɣaɣ nɛ pawɩɣaɣ se paɖʋʋ nɛ paɖʋʋ.

Payoff Matrix (kpɛlɛɛyɔɔ pɩnzɩ pɩnzɩ):
- Pɩnzɩ pɩnzɩ paɖʋʋ ➜ ɛyaa {cooperate_reward}
- Pɩnzɩ pɩnzɩ paɖʋʋ ➜ ɛyaa {mutual_defect_reward}
- Ɛyʋʋ ɖʋʋ, ɛyʋʋ paɖʋʋ ➜ Ɛyʋʋ ɖʋʋ {defect_reward}, Ɛyʋʋ paɖʋʋ {sucker_reward}

Kpɛlɛɛyɔɔ:
- Kpɛlɛɛyɔɔ taa: tɔm tɔm tɔm tɔm.
- Kpɛlɛɛyɔɔ taa: '[Cooperate]' nɛ '[Defect]' (kpɛlɛɛyɔɔ taa). Aweyiɣaɣ tɔm tɔm tɔm pɩnzɩ pɩnzɩ.

phases.conversation_finished: Kɔvɛrɩsɩ kɩlɩ wayɩ mbʊ yɔ round {round}. Pɩlɩna '[Cooperate]' mbʊ yɔ '[Defect]' ɖɔnɛ ɛzɩma \boxed{{}}.

outcome.round_p0_cooperates_p1_defects: Aleɣya laɖʋ 0 ɖʋ ɛ-taa, aleewaa 1 ñese.
outcome.round_p0_defects_p1_cooperates: Aleɣya laɖʋ 0 kʋyɩ nɛ ɛɖɛɛ, aleewaa 1 ñalabɩ nɔɔ kʋɖʋmaɣ.
